title: Jacob's Children and Prosperity

questions.question: Who did Rachel give to Jacob as a wife to bear children?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:3-4: Rachel gave her servant Bilhah to Jacob.

questions.question: Who did Leah give to Jacob as a wife?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:9: Leah gave her servant Zilpah to Jacob.

questions.question: What did Rachel trade for mandrakes?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:15-16: Rachel traded a night with Jacob for Reuben's mandrakes.

questions.question: Did Jacob become wealthy while with Laban?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:43: Jacob increased greatly in wealth.

questions.question: How many sons did Jacob have through his wives and servants?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30: Eleven sons were born before Benjamin (chapter 35).

questions.question: What wages did Jacob ask from Laban?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:32: Jacob asked for every speckled and spotted sheep.

questions.question: What did Jacob use to influence the breeding of the flocks?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:37-38: Jacob peeled rods and placed them at the watering places.

questions.question: Who was Dan's mother?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:5-6: Bilhah bore Dan to Jacob.

questions.question: What does Joseph mean?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:24: Rachel said "May the LORD add to me another son."

questions.question: How many sons did Bilhah bear for Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:5-8: Bilhah bore Dan and Naphtali.

questions.question: How many sons did Zilpah bear for Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:10-13: Zilpah bore Gad and Asher.

questions.question: What was Leah's sixth son named?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:20: Leah's sixth son was Zebulun.

questions.question: When did Jacob ask to leave Laban?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:25: "As soon as Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban..."

questions.question: Which animals did Jacob selectively breed?
questions.explanation: Genesis 30:41-42: Jacob used the rods with stronger animals only.

key_verse_text: Thus the man increased greatly and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
